purpose: Phase-7C Section 4 final adaptive + net immune integration coefficients. Combines innate + CD8 + CD4 + Treg + checkpoint + integrated suppression + immune escape into adaptive readiness / activation / effector competence / effective cytotoxic potential / persistence / recovery / burdens / blocked potential, then the net immune layer (readiness, competence, net immune-mediated tumour-loss potential, blocked immune potential, immune control + failure states). Uses the Section-2 aggregation framework only (no ad-hoc math). Escape is applied to effective cytotoxic potential ONLY where its causes were not already applied (ledger-gated). Net tumour-loss is a POTENTIAL - it never mutates tumour burden. Prediction-only; schematic [0,1].
control_note: immune control considers realized immune pressure AND escape burden; control + failure are NOT exact inverses (a mixed state may exist). Neither infers tumour elimination.

coefficient_policy.valid_range: every output in [0,1]; signed weights denote applied penalties within a bounded aggregation
coefficient_policy.source: general integrated tumour-immunology biology applied predictively
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: net tumour-loss is a POTENTIAL published for a downstream tumour engine; Phase 7C never mutates tumour state.
coefficient_policy.limitations: No absolute tumour-cell kill count / rate (NOT_REPORTED).
